subject: How to define latent variable consisting of 2 other latent variables in SEM model

messages.author: 89be449d770b3cc2
messages.subject: How to define latent variable consisting of 2 other latent variables in SEM model
parts:
Hello,

I have latent variable Text consisting of latent variables Textmat and Textsoc. Textmat is measured by extmat1, extmat2 and extmat3. Textsoc is measured by extsoc1, extsoc2 and extsoc3.

How should I build my SEM model?

# measurement model MWMS
          Textsoc =~ extsoc1 + extsoc2 + extsoc3
          Textmat =~ extmat1 + extmat2 + extmat3 
          Text =~ extsoc1 + extsoc2 + extsoc3 + extmat1 + extmat2 + extmat3
          Tintroj =~ introj1 + introj2 + introj3 + introj4
          Tident =~ ident1 + ident2 + ident3
          Tintrin =~ intrin1 + intrin2 + intrin3
...

or

# measurement model MWMS
          Textsoc =~ extsoc1 + extsoc2 + extsoc3
          Textmat =~ extmat1 + extmat2 + extmat3 
          Text =~ Textsoc + Textmat
          Tintroj =~ introj1 + introj2 + introj3 + introj4
          Tident =~ ident1 + ident2 + ident3
          Tintrin =~ intrin1 + intrin2 + intrin3
...

or is there a specific method for doing this?

Thank you for your help!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: How to define latent variable consisting of 2 other latent variables in SEM model
parts: is there a specific method for doing this?

Your first specification is called a bifactor model, and would require constraining Text to be uncorrelated with Textmat and Textsoc.  The second specification is called a hierarchical, or second-order, factor model, and it would require fixing both Textmat and Textsoc loadings on Text to 1 to freely estimate the variance of Text (which is statistically equivalent to the covariance between Textmat and Textsoc if you left Text out of the model).  Here is an article that compares the two approaches:

www.mdpi.com/2079-3200/5/3/27/pdf

You can find out more by asking about these models on SEMNET, which is a general forum (and you question is not specific to lavaan).

http://www2.gsu.edu/~mkteer/semnet.html
